An unofficial, non-commercial fan RPG set on Roshar, the world of Brandon Sanderson's *The Stormlight Archive*. Free, and not for sale.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `Oathbound-Setup-1.0.1.exe` |
| Windows, without installing | `Oathbound-Portable-1.0.1.exe` |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later) | `Oathbound-1.0.1-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel chip | `Oathbound-1.0.1-x64.dmg` |

To check your Mac's chip, open the Apple menu and choose About This Mac.

## The first time you open it

The app isn't signed with a paid developer certificate, so your computer will warn you the first time.

**Windows:** choose More info, then Run anyway.

**Mac:**
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag Oathbound to Applications.
2. Open Oathbound. macOS will refuse, so choose Done.
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down, choose Open Anyway, and confirm.

If macOS says the app is damaged, run this in Terminal and open it again:

```
xattr -cr /Applications/Oathbound.app
```

## Save files

Your games are saved as files, which you can copy to back them up or move them to another computer. Menu > System > Open save folder takes you there.

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\Oathbound\saves`
- Mac: `~/Library/Application Support/Oathbound/saves`
